description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Damage Cap +10000] and Crystal Mode to the user, grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] to the user depending on entry damage
Crystal Mode: Lightning/Dark Ability Boost, Dualcast Lightning/Dark, Zero Hone Cost to Lightning/Dark Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 6 single Lightning/Dark/NE physical attacks (2.00 each) capped at 19999, Instant Cast, grants [Damage +30% Boost 2] to all allies with [Attach Lightning] or [Attach Dark], grants [Quick Cast 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], and [200% ATB 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Dark
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Dark damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Dark resistance +20%

description.name: DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2
description.text: Ignores 50% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: 200% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x2.00
